description_en: Queries the destination route entries and BGP route entries of a VPN gateway instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnRouteEntries接口查询VPN网关实例的目的路由条目信息和BGP路由条目信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-route-entries --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-gateway-id vpn-bp1cmw7jh1nfe43m90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnRouteEntries

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPN gateway instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway
parameters.name: vpn_gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the route entry. Valid values:

custom (default): queries the destination routes of the VPN gateway instance.
bgp: queries the BGP routes of the VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh:
路由条目的类型。取值：

custom（默认值）：表示查询VPN网关实例的目的路由。
bgp：表示查询VPN网关实例的BGP路由
parameters.name: route_entry_type

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging queries
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list

VpnRouteCount.description_en:
The route statistics of the dual-tunnel mode VPN gateway instance.

This information is returned only for VPN gateway instances that support dual-tunnel mode IPsec-VPN connections
VpnRouteCount.description_zh:
双隧道模式VPN网关实例的路由条目统计信息。

仅支持双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回该组信息

RouteEntryType.description_en:
The type of the route entry.

custom: destination route entry.
bgp: BGP route entry
RouteEntryType.description_zh:
路由条目类型。

custom：目的路由条目。
bgp：BGP路由条目

Source.description_en:
The source of the BGP route.

CLOUD: the route is propagated from an Alibaba Cloud service associated with the VPN gateway.
VPN_BGP: the route is learned through the BGP routing protocol of the VPN gateway, such as routes learned from an on-premises data center through BGP
Source.description_zh:
BGP路由条目的来源。

CLOUD：表示当前路由是通过VPN网关关联的阿里云产品传播过来的。
VPN_BGP：表示当前路由是通过VPN网关BGP路由协议学习到的，例如通过BGP路由协议学习本地数据中心的路由

items.description_en: The details of the route entry

AsPath.description_en: The AS path of the route entry

Community.description_en: The community attribute value of the route entry

CreateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the route entry was created.

The timestamp is in the UNIX format and represents the total number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CreateTime.description_zh:
创建路由条目的时间戳。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建路由条目时的总时长

NextHop.description_en: The next hop of the route entry

NextHopTunnelId.description_en:
The tunnel ID associated with the next hop of the route entry.

This parameter is returned only for VPN gateway instances that support dual-tunnel mode IPsec-VPN connections
NextHopTunnelId.description_zh:
路由条目下一跳关联的隧道ID。

仅支持双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的VPN网关实例会返回当前参数

RouteDest.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

RouteEntryType.description_en:
The type of the route entry.

custom: a destination route of the VPN gateway instance.
bgp: a BGP route of the VPN gateway instance
RouteEntryType.description_zh:
路由条目的类型。

custom：表示VPN网关实例的目的路由。
bgp：表示VPN网关实例的BGP路由

Source.description_en:
The source of the BGP route.

CLOUD: the route is propagated from an Alibaba Cloud service associated with the VPN gateway.
VPN_BGP: the route is learned through the BGP routing protocol of the VPN gateway, such as routes learned from an on-premises data center through BGP
Source.description_zh:
BGP路由条目的来源。

CLOUD：表示当前路由是通过VPN网关关联的阿里云产品传播过来的。
VPN_BGP：表示当前路由是通过VPN网关BGP路由协议学习到的，例如通过BGP路由协议学习本地数据中心的路由

State.description_en:
The status of the route entry. Valid values:

published: published.
normal: not published
State.description_zh:
路由条目的状态。取值：

published：已发布。
normal：未发布

VpnInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPN gateway

Weight.description_en:
The weight of the destination route.

For VPN gateway instances that support dual-tunnel mode IPsec-VPN connections, the weight of the destination route defaults to 100 and has no practical significance.
For VPN gateway instances that support single-tunnel mode IPsec-VPN connections, the weight represents the priority of the destination route:
    - 100: high priority. When multiple destination routes with the same destination CIDR block exist, the IPsec-VPN connection associated with this destination route serves as the active link.
    - 0: low priority. When multiple destination routes with the same destination CIDR block exist, the IPsec-VPN connection associated with this destination route serves as the standby link
Weight.description_zh:
目的路由的权重值。

对于支持IPsec-VPN连接双隧道模式的VPN网关实例，目的路由的权重值默认为100，且无实际意义。
对于支持IPsec-VPN连接单隧道模式的VPN网关实例，目的路由权重值代表目的路由的优先级：
    - 100：表示高优先级。存在目标网段相同的多条目的路由时，该目的路由关联的IPsec连接为主链路。
    - 0：表示低优先级。存在目标网段相同的多条目的路由时，该目的路由关联的IPsec连接为备链路
